edges.reason: addPVP stores the _uri parameter into the new Pvp struct
addPVP stores the _price parameter into the new Pvp struct
addPVP stores the _units parameter into the new Pvp struct
addPVP builds the newPVP local struct from its parameters
addPVP increments the _charId state counter before storing the new Pvp
addPVP writes the newly created Pvp into the pvps mapping
mint consumes the charId parameter to index pvps
mint loads the pvp local struct from pvps[charId]
mint increments the _tokenId state counter
mint reads and increments pvps[charId].currentUnits
mint calls _safeMint which performs an external callback before the state update to currentUnits completes
mint calls _setTokenURI to persist the token metadata
mint indirectly triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook through _safeMint
admint consumes the charId parameter to index pvps
admint uses the recipient parameter as the mint destination
admint loads the pvp local struct from pvps[charId]
admint increments the _tokenId state counter
admint reads and increments pvps[charId].currentUnits
admint calls _safeMint which performs an external callback before the state update to currentUnits completes
_safeMint invokes IERC721ReceiverUpgradeable.onERC721Received on an attacker-controlled contract, enabling reentrant calls during minting
_safeMint calls _mint which executes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
msg.sender is passed as the mint recipient of _safeMint, letting any caller become the token owner
withdrawAll is public with no onlyOwner guard, so any caller (including any msg.sender) can trigger it
withdrawAll assigns address(this).balance to the amount local variable
withdrawAll performs a low-level send of the entire balance with no access control protecting the operation
an arbitrary msg.sender reaches the unprotected send, draining the contract balance to the owner without authorization
the low-level send transfers execution to owner() and can re-enter withdrawAll before completion

normalization_plan.reason: _uri is only meaningful as the metadata input consumed by addPVP, so it folds into that core function node
_price is only meaningful as the pricing input of addPVP, so it folds into that core function node
_units is only meaningful as the supply input of addPVP, so it folds into that core function node
newPVP is a transient struct local built inside addPVP and absorbed by that function node
charId is only used to index pvps inside mint, so it folds into the mint function node
pvp is a transient struct local read inside mint and absorbed by that function node
charId is only used to index pvps inside admint, so it folds into the admint function node
recipient is only used as the mint destination inside admint, so it folds into that function node
pvp is a transient struct local read inside admint and absorbed by that function node
amount exists solely to feed the low-level send in withdrawAll, so it folds into the unsafe send operation node
